fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-12-18, a gold chain weighing about 2.5 sovereigns was snatched from the complainant near Nallur Nagar Main Street by a person riding a maroon motorcycle bearing registration number TN-47-ZZ-1038. The time of the incident was given as 10:35 on 2025-12-18. The online submission was made by Gayathri Raman (9000000100). Dharani Anand (9000000114) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint mentions Ezhilan Ramasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000042, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Rider reportedly approached from behind, grabbed the chain and fled.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, two-wheeler, morning, suspect, main street, CCTV, motorcycle, witness
